d:
Avadh Ojha takes the stage at The Lallantop Bihar Adda in Patna for an unfiltered and entertaining conversation. From history and politics to Vote Chori and the hilarious Cockroach Janta Party, there is never a dull moment when Ojha is around!
Get ready for his candid opinions, witty anecdotes and signature storytelling style.
Production: Neeraj Kumar
Video Editor: Shakir & Rahul
